Currently, over 500 million DOT tokens are minted yearly, rewarding validators and stakers who often sell immediately. Reducing inflation to about 90 million tokens annually would ease sell pressure, tightening supply dynamics in the DOT market. More revolutionary still, Wood suggests replacing staking rewards with a proof-of-personhood – PAAP system PAAP empowers tokenholders with equal voting rights while reducing governance spam significantly. This governance reform could reshape Polkadot's decentralized ecosystem fostering equitable decision-making less influenced by capital concentration. Such innovation boosts investor confidence and encourages long-term holding over short term selling.
